UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

[PROPOSED] ORDER

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Consolidated Statement of Procedural Irregularities and Judicial Actions. Upon consideration of the motion, the memorandum in support, and the declaration accompanying it, it is hereby

ORDERED that the motion is GRANTED; and it is further

ORDERED that the Clerk shall docket Exhibit A to the motion, titled Plaintiff’s Consolidated Statement of Procedural Irregularities and Judicial Actions, as a separate entry on the docket of this action.

The Clerk is directed to send a copy of this Order to Plaintiff at his address of record and to counsel of record.

It is SO ORDERED.

Alexandria, Virginia

__________, 2026

______________________________

Rossie D. Alston, Jr.

United States District Judge
